title: Embedding strategy head-to-head

method.note: Each strategy is measured by its own detector, since the dataset is built from that strategy's embedding. Sized for comparison, not as a headline result.
method.robustness_note: BER measured through production SignExtractor extraction.

registry.notes: Production default. Writes carrier as +/-|r| selected by the bit. Passes BER/PPL/robustness but is detected at 70.5% by a carrier-centered MLP; the sweep in exp7_neural_parameter_study shows retuning does not help.

Per-carrier adaptive margin, but still 'boosted if bit == 1 else -boosted'. Same structural sign leak as sign, with a larger perturbation, so it is expected to be at least as detectable rather than less.

LWE-inspired parity/grid encoding, not lattice LWE: there is no matrix A and no SIS/LWE instance, so the post-quantum claim in its docstring is not supported. Structurally the most promising option here (parity, not sign flip) but extraction calls residuals_ref[layer].std() to derive the grid width, so it cannot extract from stego weights alone.

Learns a (residual, bit) -> value mapping, so it is not constrained to a sign flip and is the only candidate that could learn a cover-matching distribution. Requires NeuralEmbeddingTrainer training before use.

extractability.note: Embedded, but production extraction (SignExtractor, which reads carrier signs) cannot recover a non-sign scheme's bits. A scheme-specific extractor is required.

conclusion: No strategy beats sign. Both usable schemes (sign, magnitude_aware) force a sign flip at carriers and are detected at 72.50% and 67.50% against a 55% gate. The two non-sign candidates are unusable as implemented: lwe carries no recoverable bits at all (BER 0.5048 = chance, because production SignExtractor reads carrier signs and cannot decode a parity grid), and additionally its own extract() needs the cover residuals; neural requires training a model that does not exist yet. Phase 3 should not proceed on these candidates.
key_finding: LWE's perturbation is 29x smaller than sign's (max per-patch delta 0.15 vs 4.41), which is why its detector accuracy sits at chance. That is below the detector's sensitivity, not a security proof, and it comes at the cost of carrying no recoverable bits.
